summary: Implementation satisfies the contract. Store.update() correctly handles partial fields, PATCH route returns 200/404 as specified, both required tests exist with exact names and pass. Build and tests verified independently.
findings: feature_list.json was modified in the commit but was not in the contract files_to_touch — minor scope drift (status tracking only, no functional impact).
Extra blank line before router.patch block in todos.ts — cosmetic only.

acceptance_results.criterion: PATCH /todos/:id updates title and/or completed and returns 200 with updated item
acceptance_results.notes: Route destructures title/completed from body, delegates to store.update, returns updated item with implicit 200.

acceptance_results.criterion: updatedAt changes when an update succeeds
acceptance_results.notes: store.update sets item.updatedAt = new Date(). Test asserts updatedAt differs from original.

acceptance_results.criterion: PATCH /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error for unknown id
acceptance_results.notes: Route checks if store.update returns undefined, responds with 404 and { error: "Todo not found" }.

acceptance_results.criterion: Unit test: todos.test.ts > PATCH /todos/:id updates the item verifies update
acceptance_results.notes: Test exists with exact required name, creates item then patches title+completed, asserts 200 and updated fields.

acceptance_results.criterion: Unit test: todos.test.ts > PATCH /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id verifies not-found
acceptance_results.notes: Test exists with exact required name, patches nonexistent id, asserts 404 and error JSON.
